integrity: Analytical proof is provided with a reproducible numerical checker; numerical samples cannot certify the quantified infinite family. Priority remains conditional on the available indexed literature, and independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Cycle attraction holds on the common-phase quotient only and for a graph-dependent neighborhood above the threshold; no global large-step orbit census, transversality classification, or nonbipartite bifurcation is established.
title: A sharp supercritical period-two threshold for repulsive sine networks on weighted bipartite graphs
